# BitterPass

Marketing surface only. BitterPass public context lives at `bitterpass.com`;
the product console lives at `app.bitterpass.com`; access requests and support
start at `bitterdesk.com`.

## Product Sentence

BitterPass is an operator-approved credential authority for teams whose agents
touch production APIs, cloud consoles, billing systems, and internal control
planes.

## Public Routes

- HTML home: https://bitterpass.com/
- Markdown home: https://bitterpass.com/index.md
- CLI setup overview: https://bitterpass.com/cli-setup/
- Markdown CLI setup overview: https://bitterpass.com/cli-setup.md
- Health and release identity: https://bitterpass.com/up/
- Sitemap: https://bitterpass.com/sitemap.xml
- Full AI-readable context: https://bitterpass.com/llms-full.txt
- Public source repository: https://github.com/sheetgenius/bitterpass-marketing

## Current CTA Truth

- Request access through BitterDesk: https://bitterdesk.com/
- Invited users open BitterPass Console: https://app.bitterpass.com/
- Login and signup bridge through Bitter account surfaces.
- Detailed CLI commands, pairing steps, recovery material, and
  customer-specific onboarding are invitation-gated.

## Public Claim Boundary

Public copy may describe sealed state, metadata, operator approval, scoped
runner access, revocation, and receipts. Do not infer public proof of
zero-knowledge behavior, no-service-plaintext custody, no-vendor-root custody,
or recovery guarantees from this marketing repository alone.
